about: DESIGN-UNIFY.md 4.2: the edit intents as data, run by the core (mmDeskTest: apply, the whole documents compared) and by the page (mmViewTest.js: MmView.writes over the view of docs equals the view of the documents after). docs: the base documents by name (a kind, or another slot of the library: kit0, kit5, pattern3; the schema says which): the pattern A01, the kit that plays (kit 1: its working kit and its stored slot), the active global (2), the machine's song (3), a stored kit 6 and pattern A04. given: [name, JSON path, value] set on them for every case. A case: command (or commands, applied in order with the core clipboard; the page keeps its own copy for what it shows), then after: [name, path, value] on the base that make the documents after (a path [] is the whole document; everything else unchanged), or refused: a part of the error. optimistic false: the page shows the edit only at the result (the library's slots).
